title: Ashraf Sabry's Bet That Egyptians Would Pay Bills at the Corner Shop
conflicts: Launch footprint: Daily News Egypt (April 2010) reports 700 retailers in Cairo and Alexandria plus 2,200 ATMs; Fintech News (2021) says a March 2010 launch with 5,000 points of service in two cities; story uses the contemporary 700 figure. Launch date: soft launch 1 December 2009 (press release, Daily News Egypt) vs March 2010 (Fintech News); story gives December 2009 soft launch and April 2010 retail start. Early shareholders: Sabry in 2009 named Raya, EFG Hermes and HSBC; Fintech News names Ideavelopers first, then Raya, AAIB, HSBC, Alexbank, IFC; story names none. 80% of personal resources and near-bankruptcy after three years are Sabry's own claims, attributed as such.
notes: Episode kept as the slate described (founding and first build of the network, 2008-2010), anchored on Sabry's 2019 founder interview (archived copy, the original URL now 404s) and contemporary Daily News Egypt reports from 2009, 2010 and 2013. Quote stance: complicates (James on mutual faith vs Sabry's 'never give up').
